nodes.label: Lead-to-Visit WhatsApp Agent — Agentic System Design
nodes.rationale: Designed within ArchitecturalDrivers v0.2 constraints (Chatwoot SoR conversations, wacrm SoR leads, FastAPI+Supabase AI domain, organization-ready modular monolith). ARSDA verdict 4.15 — Scale with Caution: validate PMF via journey KPIs before scaling volume.

nodes.label: Coordinator Agent (SAS)
nodes.rationale: Single LLM agent owns the entire happy-path dialogue because the task is strongly sequential with dependent states (intent→discovery→qualification→matching→objections→visit); MAS would degrade 39-70%. Context 4/5: only current state + profile + last N messages, never full history.

nodes.label: Intent Router
nodes.rationale: Single short LLM call classifying lead intent into 6 categories; low confidence triggers a confirmation question, persistent ambiguity escalates to human. Runs on a small model for cost.

nodes.label: Qualification Flow (Prompt Chaining)
nodes.rationale: Gradual discovery via sub-prompts per profile dimension, each verifiable — reduces compounded error versus one big extraction.

nodes.label: Objection Handler (LLM+RAG)
nodes.rationale: Answers objections only with verified KB evidence or declares it doesn't know — never invents figures; without KB evidence it offers to consult the broker. Kept as a SAS node (depends on conversational context) but with external KB.

nodes.label: Guardrails Layer
nodes.rationale: Last line before irreversible action: hard rules for discounts (register offer, never promise), money/documents (immediate human handoff), prices (only from inventory, never LLM memory), availability (only pre-validated slots). Risk overrides complexity — confirming a visit is conversationally simple but its failure is the critical business risk.

nodes.label: Matching Engine (deterministic + RAG)
nodes.rationale: Extracted as a deterministic non-LLM service (SQL filters + pgvector + Availability Validator) because it is reusable and independent — it will also serve the future seller flow. 0 results emit an explicit 'reframe search' signal, never a silent empty list.

nodes.label: Availability Validator
nodes.rationale: Deterministic validation bottleneck mitigating the critical business risk (booking a visit to an unavailable property, 0 tolerance KPI). 'pending' status blocks client confirmation; automatic re-check 2-4h before the visit. Marked as one of three critical failure points.

nodes.label: Scheduling Service
nodes.rationale: Deterministic service materializing a validated visit in Google Calendar with 24h/2h reminders; API failure retries with backoff and the client is never notified without external confirmation.

nodes.label: Ownership Policy Engine (rules)
nodes.rationale: Rule-based (E14 matrix) because no conversion data exists yet — registered as strategic debt with exit plan: ML optimization over OwnershipDecision+Outcome in Phase 3. Stale wacrm data (>60s) forces re-sync before deciding.

nodes.label: BuyerProfile
nodes.rationale: Persistent memory-managed profile with immutable versioning — the agent never overwrites, it appends versions. Completeness checkpoint before matching cuts propagation of bad profiles.

nodes.label: SAS + Deterministic Services Hybrid Decision
nodes.rationale: SAS chosen over MAS because: task is strongly sequential with dependent states; a single well-tooled agent clears the 45% baseline rule; ~8-10 tools would fragment token budget across agents in MAS; low error tolerance demands a centralized validation bottleneck (contains error amplification to 4.4x vs 17.2x). Reusable independent capabilities are extracted as non-LLM services. Seller flow (A6) routed to a future independent agent — different domain.

nodes.label: Autonomy Matrix (Risk × Complexity)
nodes.rationale: Assigns autonomy level per system decision: greetings/FAQs fully autonomous; discount negotiation and money/documents are human-only hard guardrails; visit confirmation requires deterministic availability validation. Rule: risk dominates complexity.

nodes.label: LangGraph Framework Recommendation
nodes.rationale: LangGraph scored 4.65 weighted (vs Pydantic AI 3.80, ADK 3.85, CrewAI 2.80, Agno 3.30): the Nuevo→Dormant→Reactivated lifecycle demands persistent resumable checkpoints (conversations sleeping weeks) and first-class HITL interrupts for Rules 1-4. Pydantic AI runner-up: its models define tool contracts INSIDE LangGraph nodes (combination, not exclusion). CrewAI discarded: role crews add nothing to a sequential SAS; ADK couples to GCP unnecessarily.

nodes.label: Conversation State Machine (15 CRM states)
nodes.rationale: Nuevo→…→Postventa aligned to the 15 wacrm CRM states plus Dormant (reachable from any active state) and Reactivated→OwnershipEvaluation as sole re-entry. AI operates from Nuevo to VisitaAgendada; from VisitaRealizada onward the owner is human (E14 scenarios 3-4).

nodes.label: Error Compounding Mitigation
nodes.rationale: ~6 chained LLM decisions at 90% each ≈ 53% end-to-end success — unacceptable. Mitigation: highest-risk steps (matching, availability, scheduling) made deterministic and removed from the probabilistic chain; profile completeness checkpoint before matching; explicit lead confirmations (user as free validator). Effective chain ~4 steps at 95% target ≈ 81-85% expected; failures fall to reframe/escalate paths, never to a mis-booked visit.

nodes.label: Eval Pipeline (10 QA cases in CI/CD)
nodes.rationale: The 10 journey QA cases (property reserved mid-chat, long audio, couple from one number, price mismatch, reactivation weeks later, etc.) are the foundational eval set; regression on any QA case blocks deploy. Expanded later with anonymized real transcripts (debt: eval set is only 10 cases until +60 days).

nodes.label: AIDecisionTrace (per-decision tracing)
nodes.rationale: Every decision traces agent/node, prompt version, referenced context, tools with parameters, cost, latency, output and resulting state (Gate 9); stored in Supabase and surfaced in the AI Sidebar for broker explainability.

nodes.label: Typed Tool Contracts (9 tools)
nodes.rationale: 9 typed contracts (get_lead, update_profile, search_properties, check_availability, propose_slots, book_visit, send_property_pack, handoff, register_offer). Key controls: price ALWAYS from the system never conversational context (QA-6); book_visit requires Status=confirmed plus intent validation; register_offer only records, never accepts (Rule 2).

nodes.label: AI Sidebar (Chatwoot)
nodes.rationale: Human review surface: edge-case qualification review, escalation target for guardrails, and explainability window over decision traces.

nodes.label: ARSDA Scorecard (4.15 — Scale with Caution)
nodes.rationale: 10-gate scorecard: build capability now, scale volume only after Gate 1 (PMF validation). Bottlenecks to monitor: PMF validation and wacrm availability. Horizontal/vertical calls: Availability Validator and Matching separated (reusable); ranking/filtering integrated into Matching; Objection Handler integrated as SAS node with external KB.

hyperedges.label: Deterministic non-LLM Services Extracted from the SAS
